mainEntity.name: What happens if there are damaged cabinets upon delivery?

acceptedAnswer.text: If cabinets arrive damaged, it's crucial to document the damage immediately by taking photographs and noting it on the delivery receipt. Timely reporting allows for a quicker resolution with the cabinet supplier or manufacturer. Frasheski Construction’s coordination service includes inspecting deliveries upon arrival. If damage is found, we manage the process of reordering or repairing the affected components and adjust the installation schedule as needed. Our goal is to minimize project delays and ensure that only pristine materials are installed in your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: If cabinets arrive damaged, document it immediately with photos and note on the delivery receipt. We handle inspection, reordering, and schedule adjustments to minimize delays.
